resources.string: Nozzle, bed and AMS readings over the last hours or days
The dashed line is the target temperature.
Bambuddy records temperatures while it\'s connected to the printer. Try a longer time, or check back after the printer has been on for a while.
Recorded by Bambuddy, which keeps up to a week. The AMS lite has no humidity or temperature sensor, so it has no history here.
This API key can\'t read printer history. Edit the key in Bambuddy and turn on \"Read Status\".
K-factor calibrations stored on the printer
The printer has no pressure advance calibrations for a %1$s mm nozzle. Pick another size above, or calibrate in your slicer or on the printer.
Read from the printer through Bambuddy, which needs it to be online. Bambuddy only lets a logged-in admin change or delete profiles, so they can\'t be edited with an API key.
This API key can\'t read pressure advance profiles. Edit the key in Bambuddy and turn on \"Read Status\".
Bambu Lab has a newer firmware for this printer. Update it on the printer\'s screen or in Bambu Handy.
